item.title: Monetary Policy Statement, 2026-27 Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee February 3 to 5, 2027
item.description:
On the basis of an assessment of the current and evolving macroeconomic situation, the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) at its meeting today (February 5, 2027) decided to:

  • Reduce the policy repo rate under the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF) by 25 basis points to 5.50 per cent from 5.75 per cent with immediate effect.

Consequently, the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate under the LAF shall stand adjusted to 5.25 per cent, and the marginal standing facility (MSF) rate and the Bank Rate to 5.75 per cent.

In December 2026 the MPC had increased the policy repo rate by 25 bps to 5.75 per cent.

Dr. A. Member, Dr. B. Member, Shri C. Member, Dr. D. Member and Shri E. Member voted to reduce the policy repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50 per cent. Prof. F. Member voted to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 5.75 per cent.

The next meeting of the MPC is scheduled during April 5 to 7, 2027.

(A. Officer)
Chief General Manager

item.title: Monetary Policy Statement, 2026-27 Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee December 2 to 4, 2026
item.description:
On the basis of an assessment of the current and evolving macroeconomic situation, the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) at its meeting today (December 4, 2026) decided to:

  • Increase the policy repo rate under the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF) by 25 bps to 5.75 per cent.

Consequently, the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate stands adjusted at 5.50 per cent and the marginal standing facility (MSF) rate and the Bank Rate at 6.00 per cent.

All members of the MPC – Dr. A. Member, Dr. B. Member, Shri C. Member, Dr. D. Member, Shri E. Member and Prof. F. Member – voted unanimously to increase the policy repo rate under the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF) by 25 bps to 5.75 per cent.

The next meeting of the MPC is scheduled during February 3 to 5, 2027.

(A. Officer)
Chief General Manager

On the basis of an assessment of the current and evolving macroeconomic situation, the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) at its meeting today (August 5, 2026) decided to keep the policy repo rate under the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF) unchanged at 5.25 per cent. Consequently, the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate remains at 5.00 per cent and the marginal standing facility (MSF) rate and the Bank Rate at 5.50 per cent.
